item.title: Self-Hosted RPA and Automation Platforms: OpenRPA vs TagUI vs Robot Framework
item.description: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) uses software robots to automate repetitive, rule-based tasks that humans perform across applications and systems. While commercial RPA platforms like UiPath and Automation Anywhere dominate the enterprise market, three open-source alternatives provide capable self-hosted automation: OpenRPA, TagUI, and Robot Framework. Each targets a different audience and automation style.
